title: Fashion District Adventures With David Choe: From Ninjas to Road Rage
description: Tasked with outfits for VeggieHammerr, Choe shops the Los Angeles Fashion District for fabric and hardware, takes styling advice, admits he cannot sew, remembers a late collaborator's final video and closes by confronting his own road rage in traffic.
